vulns.summary: Path traversal and file disclosure (and possible RCE) in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49.

Backdoor command execution in the vsftpd 2.3.4 distribution tarball.
PHP2Shell: critical unauthenticated remote code execution (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Public exploit circulating; NSA/FBI urged immediate patching.
